statement: ∀ s : ℝ, ∀ f g : KdVPlan.Coeff, KdVPlan.MemH s f → KdVPlan.MemH s g → KdVPlan.MemH s (f+g) ∧ KdVPlan.hn s (f+g) ≤ KdVPlan.hn s f+KdVPlan.hn s g ∧ KdVPlan.MemH s (f-g) ∧ KdVPlan.hn s (f-g) ≤ KdVPlan.hn s f+KdVPlan.hn s g
proof:
intro s f g hf hg
rcases (h_T013.1 s f).mp hf with ⟨x, rfl⟩
rcases (h_T013.1 s g).mp hg with ⟨y, rfl⟩
have ha : KdVPlan.FromLP s x + KdVPlan.FromLP s y = KdVPlan.FromLP s (x+y) := by
  funext k
  simp [KdVPlan.FromLP, mul_add]
have hs : KdVPlan.FromLP s x - KdVPlan.FromLP s y = KdVPlan.FromLP s (x-y) := by
  funext k
  simp [KdVPlan.FromLP, mul_sub]
rw [ha, hs]
refine ⟨(h_T013.1 s _).mpr ⟨x+y,rfl⟩, ?_, (h_T013.1 s _).mpr ⟨x-y,rfl⟩, ?_⟩
· simpa only [h_T013.2.1] using norm_add_le x y
· simpa only [h_T013.2.1] using norm_sub_le x y
